mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals monetary easing that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in >50% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) falls below 5.0%, it indicates labor market tightness that boosts consumer spending and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in >50% of instances when UNRATE < 5.0%, or correlation with positive returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: The joint increase in GDP growth (GDPC1) above 1.0% and housing starts (HOUST) above 1000 units signals robust consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in >50% of instances when both conditions hold, or interaction term in regression model is not significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In high-inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 3.0% YoY), a decline in FEDFUNDS signals central bank response to inflation, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in >50% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 3.0% and FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) above 100.0 index level indicates manufacturing strength that correlates with rising corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in >50% of instances when INDPRO increases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A month-over-month retail sales increase (RSAFS) exceeding 0.5% signals strong consumer spending that drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in >50% of instances when RSAFS > 0.5% MoM, or correlation with positive returns is not significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: The joint condition of employment growth (PAYEMS > 0.3% MoM) and falling unemployment (UNRATE < 5.0%) indicates labor market strength that fuels spending and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in >50% of instances when both conditions hold, or interaction term in regression model is not significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In housing market recovery (HOUST > 1000 and rising), concurrent GDP growth (GDPC1) above 1.0% annualized signals sustained economic expansion that drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: housing market recovery with GDP growth
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in >50% of instances when HOUST > 1000 and rising and GDPC1 > 1.0%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.
